text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In a televised interview, Symboli Rudolf 
declared that she would transform the 
racing world. And to achieve that, she 
would become "The Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The public mood firmly believes Symboli 
Rudolf will usher in a new era. Mr. C.B., 
who doesn't race purely to win, cannot 
make history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer worried that Mr. C.B. might 
care about public opinion. But she simply 
laughed it off, saying there was nothing 
to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because she made a promise to her Trainer. 
"I'll keep on being the Mr. C.B. you dream 
of." It was that very promise, she said, 
that made her strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She will continue to run her races just as 
she pleases. It's precisely because she is 
that way that fans go wild and can't help 
but dream alongside her.
